title: Keeper Login Instructions
content: Follow these steps to log in to the Ericsson Keeper Password Vault. STEP 1 - Go to the Keeper vault login page at https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/# STEP 2 - Enter your Ericsson email ID in the login box. STEP 3 - Select Enterprise SSO Login and choose the EU Region. STEP 4 - Click Next. STEP 5 - You will now be logged into the Ericsson Password Vault.

title: Admin Approval for New Devices
content: Keeper may require administrator approval when a user attempts to access the vault from a new or unrecognized device. Depending on the security settings, approval may also be required after device authentication changes or when device verification is needed. Contact the Keeper support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com if approval is required.

title: Keeper Access Request
content: How to request access to Keeper and get access to the Ericsson Password Vault for the first time. If you do not have access yet, you must first raise an access request and get it approved before you can log in. STEP 1 - Raise the access request: open the Ericsson Password Vault access request link https://mysupport.ericsson.com and you will be redirected to the Ericsson MySupport portal. There, raise an access request for Ericsson Password Vault, fill in the required details, and submit the request for approval. STEP 2 - Wait for approval: wait for the request to be approved. Once it is approved you can proceed with login. STEP 3 - Log in to the Password Vault: go to https://keepersecurity.eu/vault/# and enter your Ericsson email ID in the login box. Make sure to select Enterprise SSO Login and choose the EU Region, then click Next. You will now be logged into the Ericsson Password Vault. If you need help, contact ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com.

title: Keeper Password Reset
content: If you have forgotten your Keeper account password, follow the password recovery options available for your configured authentication method. For Ericsson Enterprise SSO accounts, complete the required corporate authentication steps or contact the appropriate support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com if you cannot sign in.

title: Keeper Desktop Application Login Issue
content: If you cannot sign in to the Keeper desktop application, first check whether you can access Keeper through the web vault. If the web vault works but the desktop application does not, restart the application and check for available updates. If the issue continues, contact the Keeper support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com with the error details.

title: Keeper Shared Folder Access
content: If you cannot access a shared folder in Keeper, verify that you have been added to the correct shared folder or authorized team. If access is still unavailable, contact the folder owner or Keeper support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com to verify your permissions.

title: Keeper Two-Factor Authentication
content: Two-factor authentication adds an extra verification step when signing in to Keeper. Follow the configured authentication method and your organization's security requirements. If you cannot complete the verification, contact the appropriate support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com.

title: Keeper Account Transfer
content: When a Keeper user leaves the organization or changes roles, eligible vault records may need to be transferred according to organizational policy. Account transfer and record ownership transfer are different processes and require the appropriate permissions and authorization.

title: Keeper One-Time Share
content: Keeper One-Time Share allows eligible users to share a record securely with someone who may not have a Keeper account. The share can be configured with permitted access options and an expiration period. Follow organizational security policies when sharing sensitive information.

title: Keeper Desktop Application Update
content: If the Keeper desktop application displays an update prompt or continues to have issues after an update, check the approved software distribution method and application version. If reinstalling or updating does not resolve the issue, contact the Keeper support team at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com.

title: Keeper Device Approval Pending
content: If a device approval request is pending, check whether the required user confirmation has been received and whether administrator action is still needed. The support team should follow the approved device verification and authorization process before approving access. For help, contact ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com.

title: Keeper Secrets Manager Access
content: Keeper Secrets Manager is a separate secrets management capability used for applications, automation, and CI/CD integrations. Availability depends on the organization's subscription and configuration. Contact the Keeper service owner to confirm licensing and access requirements.

title: Contact Keeper Support
content: For any issue with the Ericsson Keeper Password Vault that you cannot resolve yourself, contact the Keeper support team by email at ericsson.password.vault.support@ericsson.com. Include a clear description of the problem, any error messages, your device and application version, and the steps you have already tried so the support team can assist you faster.
